prompt:
Subject: A teaching model of the primary sequence of glucagon.

Composition: Show one continuous unbranched peptide teaching chain laid in a broad serpentine curve, with exactly twenty-nine connected round beads. Place one amino-acid letter on each bead in this precise order: H S Q G T F T S D Y S K Y L D S R R A Q D F V Q W L M N T.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. Allow only the twenty-nine one-letter amino-acid codes on the peptide beads; no title or molecule name. No incidental labels, logos or watermark.
For each human: exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands.
Accuracy: use three horizontal rows joined at their ends into ONE continuous chain. Read row 1 left to right: H S Q G T F T S D Y. Read row 2 right to left: S K Y L D S R R A Q. Read row 3 left to right: D F V Q W L M N T. Exactly 29 beads, no duplicated letters or extra beads. Use large clear uppercase letters.
en: A continuous chain of twenty-nine lettered beads models the amino-acid sequence of glucagon.
ja: 文字を付けた二十九個のビーズが一本につながり、グルカゴンのアミノ酸配列を表しています。
